method: Read the run fn of every spec in crates/engine/src/cmd/*.rs (24 files) and the helpers they call (lib.rs run_command and undo, library.rs persist/save_prefs, sidecar.rs, files.rs, media.rs, rename.rs, import*.rs, smart.rs, originals.rs, devices.rs, memory.rs, segment/), with rg for std::fs, threads, processes, env, save_prefs and nested execute. Verified: nested execute calls use only fixed ids (nothing is `code`); develop.sync/paste/autoSync copy settings JSON; the develop and metadata clipboards are Session fields; and segment.model.download is the only network path (lightcraft-fetch HTTPS). Not counted per command (all are no-ops for OctoSense's in-memory Session::new().with_fs()): Session::execute appending ops to a host-opened library's catalog.log/presets.json, and save_prefs() rewriting its prefs.json; decoding a catalogued photo's original through the with_fs loader to render or analyse that photo; reading the installed SAM 3 weights; Session::new's one-time /usr/sbin/sysctl call on macOS (memory.rs total_ram); and XMP auto-write, which (once library.xmpPreferences/toggleAutoWriteXmp turns it on) makes every catalog-changing command write sidecars next to originals. A command is `file` when it itself reads, writes, renames, deletes or stats caller paths, originals, sidecars, folders, or the library's Originals/, Profiles/, thumbs/ or Smart Previews/ stores.

rules.why: Naming trap: undo/redo go through Session::apply_with_files, which first renames the step's folder back on disk (rename_folder_on_disk, for folder.rename/folder.move steps) and moves photo files for the SetFile ops photo.rename produced (rename::move_all with RealFs: hard_link, rename, copy, remove_file) before applying the catalog op.
evidence: crates/engine/src/rename.rs:328-387 RealFs: symlink_metadata, hard_link, rename, copy, remove_file

rules.why: Library view state on the Session (source, filter, sort, shuffle seed, selection, next/previous) and session queries (library.groups, library.state, library.previewProgress); library.cancelPreviews only sets the running build's cancel flag; library.findSimilar compares signatures of catalogued photos' decoded thumbnails and filters the view. None opens a path of its own.

Read caller-given files and folders recursively. library.importPreview probes them (import::scan); library.import adds them in place or copies them into the library's Originals/ or a `destination`, and mode move then deletes each source and its XMP sidecars after a verified copy. library.autoImportScan read_dir's the watched folder and runs the fixed library.import; library.browse read_dir's `path` and probes its photos in place as Local records.
evidence: crates/engine/src/import_move.rs:129-305 create_dir_all, hard_link/copy, remove_file of the source and sidecars
crates/engine/src/cmd/browse.rs:20-48 browse(): std::fs::read_dir, import_with(.., local: true)

rules.why: Maintain the library's on-disk stores. library.compact (Session::compact_library) rewrites the catalog snapshot; library.forgetLocal drops untouched Local records, stats their Smart Previews/ files, then compact_soon()s; library.clearPreviews clears the thumbs/ disk cache (DiskCache::clear remove_file's every cached JPEG); library.buildPreviews renders originals into that cache on a background thread; library.smartPreviews writes or deletes .lcsp proxies in the smart-previews folder.
evidence: crates/preview/src/lib.rs:127-137 + crates/preview/src/disk.rs:168-173 clear(): std::fs::remove_file per cached file
crates/engine/src/cmd/previews.rs:79-108 build(): thread renders into the preview cache

rules.why: Probe files on disk. library.missing Path::exists-checks every library photo's original and returns the paths; library.findMissing walks a caller `folder` recursively, stats and hashes candidates (std::fs::read) and relinks the matches; photo.relink checks and probes the caller's `path` and points the photo at it; photo.smartPreview stats the original and opens its .lcsp proxy header.

Library preferences, persisted to its prefs.json through save_prefs, that change later disk behaviour. library.autoImport sets a watched folder (is_dir on the caller's path) that the app scans every few seconds. library.preferences sets import develop defaults, forget-local days and the thumbs/ disk-cache budget (set_cache_mb). library.xmpPreferences/toggleAutoWriteXmp turn on XMP auto-write, after which every catalog-changing command writes sidecars next to originals. library.smartPreviewsLocation with `path` creates and write-tests that folder, then moves or deletes the existing .lcsp files.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/prefs.rs:33-102 prefs(): import_defaults, forget_local_days, set_cache_mb, save_prefs
crates/engine/src/lib.rs:320-325 run_command(): auto_write_sidecars after every catalog-changing command

rules.why: Report host/app state rather than the catalog. library.info returns the library folder path, journal and persistence stats, settings warnings and cache usage, sizing the thumbs/ folder with DiskCache::size (a directory scan). library.memory returns process-wide cache, GPU and work-gate memory accounting (crate::memory).
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/library.rs:980-1030 library.info: lib.dir, journal stats, s.media.rendered.disk().size()
crates/preview/src/disk.rs:163-166 size(): scan() of the cache directory
crates/engine/src/cmd/query.rs:201-203 library.memory -> memory.rs:275-293 memory_report(): budget(), gpu_usage(), work_gate()

rules.why: Enumerates attached cameras and memory cards: devices::devices_now read_dir's the mount roots (/Volumes on macOS; /media/$USER, /run/media/$USER and /media on Linux; drive letters D: to Z: on Windows; or LIGHTCRAFT_DEVICE_ROOTS) for volumes holding a DCIM folder and returns their paths.
evidence: crates/engine/src/devices.rs:152-177 scan()/devices_in(): std::fs::read_dir per mount root

rules.why: Catalog-only photo edits and queries: rating, flag and label; rotate/flip (develop orientation and crop flags); face regions; delete, restore and deletePermanently (catalog records only: delete_permanently_ops never touches the file); setMeta; setCaptureTime (catalog only, no EXIF rewrite); virtualCopy (a catalog entry sharing the file); addToLibrary; copy/pasteMetadata (Session.meta_clipboard, fixed photo.setMeta); renameTokens help; inspect; and analyze (decoded thumbnails of catalogued photos).
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/library.rs:397-653 copy/pasteMetadata, rate/flag/label, rotate/flip, regions, delete/restore/deletePermanently, setMeta: s.commit(Op::..)

rules.why: photo.rename renames originals and their XMP sidecars on disk (Session::apply_rename via RealFs; a taken name gets -1, -2). photo.renamePreview only plans the rename, but plan_rename stats the destination names on disk (symlink_metadata/metadata) to pick free ones. Its catalog text wrongly says it renames files.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/manage.rs:158-176 renamePreview: s.plan_rename; rename: plan_rename + apply_rename

rules.why: Write new files next to originals. convertToDng reads the raw (std::fs::read), writes a verified `<stem>.dng` (safe_file::write_new_unique) and relinks the photo to it. duplicate std::fs::copy's the original to `<stem>-copy`. editExternal renders a 16-bit `<name>-Edit.tif` beside the original (or into `dir` for demo photos) with export::write_file_durable and runs the fixed library.import and stack.group; the host app, not the engine, then launches the external editor.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/convert.rs:125-166 edit_external(): write_file_durable, fixed library.import + stack.group

rules.why: Read or write the files behind photos. saveMetadataToFile writes or merges XMP sidecars next to originals, backing up unreadable ones; readMetadataFromFile reads sidecars or embedded XMP into the catalog; allMetadata std::fs::read's the original for its EXIF and reads its sidecar; reload re-probes originals from disk (import::probe_paths).

Read caller-given files. autoTagTracklog std::fs::read_to_string's a GPX `path` and matches it offline (no geocoding; inline `gpx` text is also accepted). curve.importPresets reads .lccurve files. preset.import reads .lcpreset, XMP, .lrtemplate, DNG/JPEG/TIFF and Luminar files, folders and .zip bundles. profile.import reads .cube files, folders and zips, writes a copy into the library's Profiles/ folder (or the OS temp dir for an in-memory session) and registers the LUT process-wide.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/lut_profiles.rs:38-134 cube_files(): read_dir/read; import(): std::fs::write to Profiles/ or temp_dir, lut::register

rules.why: create_dir_all and std::fs::write a .lccurve or .lcpreset JSON file at the caller's `path`.
Removes an imported LUT profile and std::fs::remove_file's its copy when that copy is inside the library's Profiles/ folder; it also unregisters the LUT process-wide.
Read-only probe of a caller path: stats `path` (symlink_metadata) and compares its file identity with every photo's original and sidecar (Session::check_write_target).

folder.rename/folder.move rename or move a caller-given folder on disk (create_dir_all + std::fs::rename via rename_folder_on_disk; they refuse to overwrite or to move the library's own folders) and relink the photos inside.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/browse.rs:223-301 rename_folder_on_disk(): create_dir_all, std::fs::rename; move_folder(): Op::Relink

rules.why: HDR and panorama merges read the source originals' bytes (std::fs::read, or the host's file_bytes reader) and write the merged linear DNG next to the first source (safe_file::write_new_unique); preview mode with `previewPath` writes a PNG to that caller path.
Albums, album folders, smart-album rules, the target album and the Quick Collection are catalog records (an album `folder` is a catalog folder, not a disk folder).
albums.list returns the catalog's album tree as JSON.

Develop settings on catalog photos: set/adjust/merge (partial JSON), auto, white balance, curves, profiles, copy/paste through Session.clipboard, sync/autoSync/quickAdjust/matchExposure applying settings JSON to other photos, interactions, and get/controls queries. auto, autoBwMix, wbPick and targeted decode the active photo's pixels; DevelopSettings holds no paths.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/develop.rs:637-660 develop.sync: extract_groups + apply_partial (data, not commands)

rules.why: profile.favorite toggles a profile id in Session.profile_favorites (saved with the library's presets.json).
List built-in profiles and the favourites/recent menu from session state.
Crop rectangle, angle and aspect in the develop settings; crop.autoStraighten decodes the active photo and runs the fixed crop.straighten.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/develop.rs:380-508 crop.set..crop.reset: edit(); 428-437 autoStraighten: source_now(Preview) + fixed s.execute(crop.straighten)

rules.why: Upright and guided-upright corrections computed from the active photo's pixels and stored in its develop settings.
Apply, create, delete, favourite, rename, move and update develop presets held in Session.presets (persisted with the library's presets.json).
presets.list returns Session.presets.
Named versions of a photo's settings stored in the catalog.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/develop.rs:829-863 version.create/restore/delete/rename/update: catalog ops on the photo's versions

rules.why: A photo's edit history in the catalog: clear, go to a step, list.
Point Color samples: pointColor.pick decodes the active photo to sample a colour; samples are stored in its develop settings.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/color.rs:28 source_now(Thumb) in the sampling helper

rules.why: Reset the tone curve, list built-in and user curve presets, apply one, or save and delete user presets in Session.curve_presets (re-serialised into the library's prefs.json by save_prefs).

Mask shapes, brush strokes, colour samples, refinement, adjustments, selection and ordering in the photo's develop settings. AI kinds (object/prompt clicks, objectPoint, refineDetail) run the already-installed SAM 3 model from the host-set Segmenter.dir on the active photo and never start a download; with no model folder set they fail.
segment.prepare loads the installed SAM 3 model and analyses the active photo in the background so later object clicks are instant; it never downloads.

Model management state of the host. segment.model.status reports whether this build has AI masks, the model's install state and folder (is_model_dir stats it), the mirror list from LIGHTCRAFT_SAM3_MIRRORS or the app's mirrors file, and download progress. segment.model.cancel sets the download thread's cancel flag. Neither touches the network itself.
evidence: crates/engine/src/segment/mod.rs:161-166,218-226 installed(): is_model_dir; mirrors(): env var + mirrors_file

rules.why: Starts a background thread running lightcraft-fetch's HTTPS client (rustls) to download the ~3.4 GB SAM 3 weights from the mirrors (LIGHTCRAFT_SAM3_MIRRORS, then the app's mirrors file; DEFAULT_MIRRORS is empty at this revision) into the model folder, resuming .part files. It requires `acknowledged: true` and a host-set model folder.
evidence: crates/engine/src/segment/mod.rs:251-273 start_download(): mirrors(), download.start(SAM3_FILES, mirrors, dir)
crates/fetch/src/lib.rs:1-6 HTTPS client (rustls), mirrors, resume; crates/segment/src/fetch/mod.rs:42-46 DEFAULT_MIRRORS empty, MIRRORS_ENV

rules.why: Spot removal (heal/clone) in the develop settings; findDust and the automatic source search read the active photo's decoded pixels.
Red-eye and pet-eye corrections stored in the develop settings.
Stacks (group, ungroup, reorder, collapse, auto-stack by capture time) are catalog records.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/organize.rs:104-231 photo.virtualCopy and stack.* specs: commit_ops on catalog stacks

rules.why: Keyword tree queries and catalog-wide keyword rename/delete/merge; keyword sets and recent keywords live in the Session (re-serialised into prefs.json by save_prefs); toggleFromSet runs the fixed photo.setMeta.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/keywords.rs:73 specs(); 44-56 note_recent(): session list + save_prefs

rules.why: Colour-label names are catalog ops (SetLabelName); label sets live in Session.label_sets (re-serialised into prefs.json by save_prefs).
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/manage.rs:240-310 label.setNames/applySet: Op::SetLabelName; saveSet/deleteSet: s.label_sets, save_prefs

rules.why: catalog.query and catalog.stats read the in-memory catalog.

Process-wide app settings. app.gpu flips the global GPU switch (lightcraft_gpu::set_enabled, a static AtomicBool) and reports the adapter; app.memoryBudget sets the process memory budget (memory::set_budget, which also resizes the decode gate and GPU pool) and this session's cache share.
evidence: crates/engine/src/memory.rs:73-80 set_budget(): BUDGET for the process, apply()

rules.why: journal.list returns the session's in-memory command journal; it replays nothing.
Metadata presets in Session.metadata_presets (re-serialised into prefs.json by save_prefs); applyPreset runs the fixed photo.setMeta on catalog photos.
evidence: crates/engine/src/cmd/metadata.rs:73-158 save/delete: s.metadata_presets, save_prefs; apply: fixed s.execute(photo.setMeta)

rules.why: Filter presets in Session.filter_presets (re-serialised into prefs.json by save_prefs); applyPreset sets Session.filter.
export.presets/savePreset/deletePreset manage Session.export_presets (re-serialised into prefs.json by save_prefs). No export runs here: app.export is not in this catalog.

Engine session state, not a window or panel: setBefore, copyAfterToBefore and resetBefore store the before-side settings in Session.before (used to render the comparison), while copyBeforeToAfter and swap commit develop settings to the catalog (undoable).
